newsitem.title: UK: Whitehead Mann to float on London Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Whitehead Mann to float on London Stock Exchange.

text.p: Whitehead Mann Group Plc, an executive search company specialising in high level appointments, said on Monday it planned to list on the London Stock Exchange via a placing.

The float will value the company, which is not raising any new money with the placing, at between 20.0 and 25.0 million stg, a spokesman said. Impact day is scheduled for March 19, with first dealings a week later.
Chief executive Clive Mann said the listing would fund the development of the business in certain market sectors in which Whitehead Mann had identified potential for growth.
"The Stock Exchange listing will assist us in recruiting and retaining the high quality consultants which we require to take full advantage of these growth opportunities," Mann said.
"In addition, we believe there are possibilities for growth from international expansion and selective acquisitions, which the listing will also facilitate."

The sectors include biotechnology and pharmaceuticals, financial services plus information technology and telecoms, the company said. The broker to the issue is Sutherlands Ltd and the sponsor is Rea Brothers.
